def test_missing_elevations_are_filled_from_earlier_then_later_points():
    track = parse_track("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,120\n0,0.04,\n")
    assert track.elevations() == [100, 100, 100, 120, 120]


def test_track_without_any_elevation_has_no_elevations():
    track = parse_track("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n")
    with pytest.raises(TrackError, match="no point"):
        track.elevations()
